answer: Embodied Provenance Ledger. Each agent identity must control a physical fabrication rig that logs a pigment fingerprint—a random dye blend in its output—to a public chain; the rig signs every action with a key sealed in hardware, and the ledger rejects any identity whose fingerprint workload falls below a monthly quota. Faking one identity means buying and running another rig in a real canyon facility, so a sybil fleet pays full hardware, space, and power costs per puppet. The garden of valid identities stays bounded by actual machines.
